listing.title: Colosseum Crypto World's Fair Hackathon | Superteam Vietnam Track
listing.description:
About Superteam Vietnam

Superteam Vietnam is the local hub of the global Superteam network, supporting builders, founders, and contributors in Vietnam to learn, build, connect, and grow within the Solana ecosystem.

Through builder programs, education, community initiatives, ecosystem connections, and opportunities to go global, Superteam Vietnam helps local talent turn ideas into real products and take the next step in their builder journey.

Your Road to Colosseum Starts Here — Side Track Registration Is Open

We’re excited to announce Road to Colosseum, a four-week builder program hosted by Superteam Vietnam to support builders on their journey to Colosseum.

We’ll look for a solid GTM plan, ideally with some early traction, a strong founder background and a creative idea.

Built as a local side-track program, Road to Colosseum helps builders move from idea to product, Demo Day, and a stronger Colosseum submission through hands-on workshops, mentorship, ecosystem resources, and direct feedback from experienced builders and industry leaders.

With a $10,000 cash prize pool, infrastructure credits, and access to the wider Solana builder ecosystem, this is your chance to build something real — and take it further.

Here’s what you can expect:

We will run workshops in person alongside online. Our mentor pool includes local and international experts. Pitch day is in person, but teams unable to travel can pitch online.

Remote teams will still have full access to every mentor, session recording, and the same judging standards.

Hands-On Learning: Join practical sessions covering Colosseum, the Solana ecosystem, developer tools, infrastructure, and the fundamentals needed to start building.

Expert Mentorship: Get direct feedback from experienced founders, developers, investors, and ecosystem leaders throughout your build journey.

Builder Workshops: Meet and build alongside the community through offline workshops and working sessions across Hanoi, Da Nang, Ho Chi Minh & Vung Tau City.

Demo Day: Pitch your product in front of the judging panel, get real feedback, and show what you’ve built.

Infrastructure Support: Access credits, discounts, and developer resources from infrastructure partners across wallets, RPCs, security, data, payments, and more.

Prizes & Builder Resources

Road to Colosseum features a $10,000 cash prize pool, plus infrastructure credits, mentorship, security, and go-to-market support from ecosystem partners and innovation centers including National Startup Support Center (NSSC)  and Da Nang Innovation Startup Support Center (DISSC).

Partner benefits include:

  • Solscan: 3 free Solscan Pro API Lite spots per team throughout the program, plus 30 extra days for teams advancing to the Colosseum Global Hackathon and direct technical support from Solscan engineers.

  • Solami: Pro Plan access for each participant with 200 requests/second, 2 gRPC streams, and 5TB extra bandwidth, plus $2,000 in additional prizes for top teams using Solami.

  • Souls Lab: Strategic positioning, market-entry, GTM, and community distribution support for selected teams.

  • Themis: Free security scans, discounted audits, and security consultation.

Additional resources and support will come from MonkeDAO, Solflare, Paymoji, Hashgraph and more ecosystem partners to be announced.

Register now our Workshop and Office hours: https://luma.com/superteam-vietnam

Rewards

  • 🥇 First Prize: $4,000 USDC

  • 🥈 Second Prize: $2,000 USDC

  • 🥉 Third Prize: $1,000 USDC

  • 3 Side Track Prize: $1,000 USDC

Eligibility

To be eligible for Road to Colosseum, your project must:

  • Submit your info here and join the group: https://t.me/+omfclXsW2z04Mjhl

  • Meet the official eligibility requirements of the Colosseum Global Hackathon.

  • The Project must be submitted to the Colosseum portal as well as on Superteam Earn. 

  • Register on the Colosseum platform and select “Vietnam” as your base country.

  • You must pitch your project on our Demo Day (4th October) (Online accepted)

Full details:https://x.com/SuperteamVN/status/2099532805227303290?s=20

Build. Ship. Show your #PROOFofBUILD.
